 Print Actress Pavitra Punia has strongly criticised Bigg Boss 20 contestants Scout OP and Love Gill over their equation inside the house. Reacting to the recent incident in which Scout shaved his head following an argument with Love, Pavitra questioned their claims of sharing a brother-sister bond. In a strongly worded video shared on social media, the actress said their behaviour was inappropriate and should not be presented as a sibling relationship. Pavitra began by explaining how sibling relationships are usually filled with fights, arguments and playful mischief. Sharing examples from her own childhood, she said, “My brother has personally shot arrows at me, hit me on my legs and even burst crackers around me. This Diwali, he burst an anar near my foot and burnt my toes. This is actually what a brother-sister relationship looks like.” She further explained that siblings often exchange harsh words and refuse to speak to each other after arguments, but that does not change their bond. “Sometimes, if my brother says something to me and stops talking, I simply tell him to leave. This is how we talk to our brothers and sisters,” she added. Questioning Scout and Love’s equation, Pavitra said she does not usually make videos about Bigg Boss but felt compelled to speak about the ongoing situation. She said, “I don’t watch Bigg Boss. My brother actually watches the show, and I haven’t even watched my own season. But what is this? This is not a brother-sister relationship.” Pavitra also questioned whether the two contestants were deliberately creating such situations for content. Calling their behaviour “very cheap” and “the highest level of cheapness,” she said they had brought an otherwise pure relationship into question. She further urged them to keep such behaviour outside the show rather than making a mockery of the sibling bond. Join conversation

 She also appealed to the Bigg Boss team to intervene, saying, “I really request Bigg Boss also that please don’t allow this. The team is super smart, and I know those people personally. I’m sure somewhere they are also in shock, wondering what these people are doing.” Taking a dig at Scout, Pavitra added that while her own brother would never shave his head for her, he would probably make her go bald instead. She also expressed happiness over Kashvi’s exit from the show, while clarifying that she did not personally know the contestant. Towards the end of her video, Pavitra made it clear that she did not agree with Scout and Love describing their equation as that of siblings. “We people who have brothers and sisters are not proud of you. Do not call this relationship a brother-sister relationship. This is pure aashiqui. It is not a brother-sister bond,” she said.
